title: 雅思·环境与气候精选 · 64 句
description: 围绕本主题练习论点、理由、条件、让步与政策评价；中英对照及逐题讲解，难度 3–5。

items.zh: 即使每个家庭都认真分类垃圾，没有合适的处理设施，回收也难以奏效。
items.en: Even if every household sorts its waste carefully, recycling is unlikely to work without suitable processing facilities.
answers: Even if every household sorts its waste carefully, recycling is unlikely to work without suitable processing facilities.
items.notes: even if 提出假设性让步；without 补充制度条件，区分个人行为与系统能力。

items.zh: 湿地被排干后，附近的社区可能更容易遭受洪水。
items.en: Once wetlands have been drained, nearby communities may become more vulnerable to flooding.
answers: Once wetlands have been drained, nearby communities may become more vulnerable to flooding.
items.notes: once 引导时间从句；be vulnerable to 后接名词或动名词。

items.zh: 对污染征税的目的，是让价格反映原本由公众承担的成本。
items.en: The purpose of taxing pollution is to make prices reflect costs that would otherwise be borne by the public.
answers: The purpose of taxing pollution is to make prices reflect costs that would otherwise be borne by the public.
items.notes: make + 宾语 + 动词原形；otherwise 表示若不如此，borne 是 bear 的过去分词。

items.zh: 与禁止所有塑料制品相比，减少不必要的包装可能更容易实施。
items.en: Reducing unnecessary packaging may be easier to implement than banning all plastic products.
answers: Reducing unnecessary packaging may be easier to implement than banning all plastic products.
items.notes: 用两个动名词短语比较可实施性；比较的是措施，不是塑料与包装本身。

items.zh: 森林的价值不仅在于储存碳，还在于为众多物种提供栖息地。
items.en: Forests are valuable not only because they store carbon but also because they provide habitats for numerous species.
answers: Forests are valuable not only because they store carbon but also because they provide habitats for numerous species.
items.notes: not only because ... but also because ... 保持原因从句平行。

items.zh: 除非替代交通方式足够可靠，否则提高停车费可能只会增加通勤者的负担。
items.en: Unless alternative transport is reliable enough, higher parking charges may simply place an additional burden on commuters.
answers: Unless alternative transport is reliable enough, higher parking charges may simply place an additional burden on commuters.
items.notes: unless 表示如果不；place a burden on sb 指增加负担。

items.zh: 曾经依赖煤矿的城镇需要新的就业机会，才能支持能源转型。
items.en: Towns that once depended on coal mining need new employment opportunities to support the energy transition.
answers: Towns that once depended on coal mining need new employment opportunities to support the energy transition.
items.notes: that 从句界定特定城镇；to support 说明目的。

items.zh: 虽然电动汽车没有尾气排放，其环境影响仍取决于电力的来源。
items.en: Although electric cars produce no exhaust emissions, their environmental impact still depends on how the electricity is generated.
answers: Although electric cars produce no exhaust emissions, their environmental impact still depends on how the electricity is generated.
items.notes: although 承认优势后限定结论；how 引导介词 on 的宾语从句。

items.zh: 让产品更容易维修，可以在它们进入回收系统之前延长使用寿命。
items.en: Making products easier to repair can extend their useful life before they enter the recycling system.
answers: Making products easier to repair can extend their useful life before they enter the recycling system.
items.notes: make + 宾语 + 形容词；before 说明维修与回收的先后次序。

items.zh: 仅靠植树无法弥补对现有原始森林的持续破坏。
items.en: Planting trees alone cannot compensate for the continued destruction of existing primary forests.
answers: Planting trees alone cannot compensate for the continued destruction of existing primary forests.
items.notes: alone 限定措施范围；compensate for 表示弥补。

items.zh: 如果水价完全不反映供水成本，节水的动力就可能不足。
items.en: If water prices failed to reflect supply costs at all, there might be little incentive to conserve water.
answers: If water prices failed to reflect supply costs at all, there might be little incentive to conserve water.
items.notes: 过去式条件从句搭配 might，讨论假设；incentive to do 表示做某事的动力。

items.zh: 城市种植的树木越多，也不一定意味着每个街区都能得到同样的遮阴。
items.en: A larger number of urban trees does not necessarily mean that every neighbourhood receives equal shade.
answers: A larger number of urban trees does not necessarily mean that every neighbourhood receives equal shade.
items.notes: not necessarily 避免绝对化；用数量与分配的区别推进论证。

items.zh: 为了减少食物浪费，超市可以对接近保质期的商品打折。
items.en: To reduce food waste, supermarkets could discount products that are approaching their use-by dates.
answers: To reduce food waste, supermarkets could discount products that are approaching their use-by dates.
items.notes: 句首不定式说明目的；use-by date 指安全食用期限。

items.zh: 只有在排放得到准确监测时，减排目标才有实际意义。
items.en: Only if emissions are measured accurately do reduction targets have practical meaning.
answers: Only if emissions are measured accurately do reduction targets have practical meaning.
items.notes: only if 前置引起主句 do 倒装；准确计量是评价目标的必要条件。

items.zh: 保护海洋需要国际合作，因为鱼群和污染物都会跨越国界。
items.en: Marine conservation requires international cooperation, since both fish populations and pollutants cross national borders.
answers: Marine conservation requires international cooperation, since both fish populations and pollutants cross national borders.
items.notes: since 引导原因从句；both A and B 并列主语搭配复数谓语。

items.zh: 被过度抽取的地下水可能需要几十年才能恢复。
items.en: Groundwater that has been overextracted may take decades to recover.
answers: Groundwater that has been overextracted may take decades to recover.
items.notes: 定语从句使用现在完成时被动语态；take + 时间 + to do 表示恢复所需时长。

items.zh: 企业不应因为包装看起来环保就声称产品可持续。
items.en: Companies should not claim that a product is sustainable merely because its packaging looks environmentally friendly.
answers: Companies should not claim that a product is sustainable merely because its packaging looks environmentally friendly.
items.notes: not ... merely because ... 否定论据的充分性；claim 后接 that 从句。

items.zh: 风电和太阳能的出力会波动，因此电网也需要储能和灵活调度能力。
items.en: Wind and solar output fluctuates, so electricity grids also need storage and flexible management.
answers: Wind and solar output fluctuates, so electricity grids also need storage and flexible management.
items.notes: so 连接因果分句；output 为不可数名词，谓语用 fluctuates。

items.zh: 与其等洪水发生后再重建，不如提前保护河流的自然蓄洪空间。
items.en: Rather than wait to rebuild after a flood, authorities should protect natural floodplains in advance.
answers: Rather than wait to rebuild after a flood, authorities should protect natural floodplains in advance.
items.notes: rather than wait 与 should protect 平行；in advance 表示事先。

items.zh: 当地居民是否支持保护区，往往取决于他们能否从中获得合理收益。
items.en: Whether local residents support a protected area often depends on their receiving a fair share of its benefits.
answers: Whether local residents support a protected area often depends on their receiving a fair share of its benefits.
items.notes: whether 从句作主语；their receiving 为动名词结构，表示居民获得收益这件事。

items.zh: 减少肉类消费是一种选择，但不同地区获得替代食品的条件并不相同。
items.en: Eating less meat is one option, but access to alternative foods varies across regions.
answers: Eating less meat is one option, but access to alternative foods varies across regions.
items.notes: 动名词短语作主语；access to 表示获取条件，varies 与不可数主语 access 一致。

items.zh: 既然已有防洪预警，就应向居民提供清晰、可执行的指示。
items.en: Given that a flood warning has been issued, residents should receive clear instructions they can act on.
answers: Given that a flood warning has been issued, residents should receive clear instructions they can act on.
items.notes: given that 表示鉴于；act on instructions 表示按指示行动，定语从句省略关系代词。

items.zh: 一项要求人们节能的政策，如果没有帮助他们改善住宅保温，就可能收效有限。
items.en: A policy that asks people to save energy may achieve little if it offers no help with home insulation.
answers: A policy that asks people to save energy may achieve little if it offers no help with home insulation.
items.notes: that 从句描述政策；if 从句指出政策工具的缺口。

items.zh: 如果当初保留了沿岸植被，风暴造成的部分损失或许可以避免。
items.en: Some storm damage might have been avoided if coastal vegetation had been preserved.
answers: Some storm damage might have been avoided if coastal vegetation had been preserved.
items.notes: might have been avoided 为过去虚拟的被动形式；避免把推测写成确定事实。

items.zh: 农业用水效率提高后，还需要限制总取水量，才能避免种植面积扩大抵消节水收益。
items.en: Improvements in irrigation efficiency need to be accompanied by limits on total extraction if expansion of farmland is not to cancel out water savings.
answers: Improvements in irrigation efficiency need to be accompanied by limits on total extraction if expansion of farmland is not to cancel out water savings.
Improvements in irrigation efficiency need to be accompanied by limits on total extraction if expansion of farmland isn't to cancel out water savings.
items.notes: be accompanied by：配套实施；cancel out：抵消。

items.zh: 依赖单一作物的农场可能更容易受到病虫害的冲击。
items.en: Farms dependent on a single crop may be more exposed to pests and disease.
answers: Farms dependent on a single crop may be more exposed to pests and disease.
items.notes: dependent on 作后置修饰。

items.zh: 长期使用某些农药可能影响附近的授粉昆虫，进而影响其他作物。
items.en: Prolonged use of certain pesticides may harm nearby pollinators and, in turn, affect other crops.
answers: Prolonged use of certain pesticides may harm nearby pollinators and, in turn, affect other crops.
items.notes: in turn：继而，连接后续影响。

items.zh: 保护土壤不仅是保持土地肥沃，也关系到未来能否稳定生产粮食。
items.en: Soil protection concerns future food security as well as the maintenance of fertile land.
answers: Soil protection concerns future food security as well as the maintenance of fertile land.
items.notes: as well as 连接两个名词短语。

items.zh: 当牧场扩张以砍伐森林为代价时，肉类价格可能没有体现完整的环境成本。
items.en: Meat prices may omit significant environmental costs when pasture expands at the expense of forests.
answers: Meat prices may omit significant environmental costs when pasture expands at the expense of forests.
items.notes: at the expense of：以牺牲某事为代价。

items.zh: 缩短食品运输距离并不一定减少总排放，因为生产方式同样重要。
items.en: Shorter food supply chains do not always mean lower total emissions, because production methods also matter.
answers: Shorter food supply chains do not always mean lower total emissions, because production methods also matter.
Shorter food supply chains don't always mean lower total emissions, because production methods also matter.
items.notes: not always：不总是，避免绝对推论。

items.zh: 耐旱作物能够帮助农民适应缺水，但不能解决所有灌溉管理问题。
items.en: Drought-resistant crops can help farmers adapt to water scarcity without resolving every irrigation management problem.
answers: Drought-resistant crops can help farmers adapt to water scarcity without resolving every irrigation management problem.
items.notes: adapt to 后接名词或动名词。

items.zh: 只有农民能承担转型期间的成本，环保耕作方式才更可能被广泛采用。
items.en: Environmentally sound farming is more likely to spread when farmers can afford the costs of transition.
answers: Environmentally sound farming is more likely to spread when farmers can afford the costs of transition.
items.notes: afford the costs：负担费用。

items.zh: 保护野生动物迁徙路线，可能需要多个行政区域共同规划。
items.en: Protecting wildlife migration routes may require coordinated planning across administrative boundaries.
answers: Protecting wildlife migration routes may require coordinated planning across administrative boundaries.
items.notes: across boundaries：跨越边界。

items.zh: 野生动物数量回升，并不意味着它们的栖息地已经恢复健康。
items.en: A recovery in wildlife numbers does not necessarily indicate that their habitats are healthy again.
answers: A recovery in wildlife numbers does not necessarily indicate that their habitats are healthy again.
A recovery in wildlife numbers doesn't necessarily indicate that their habitats are healthy again.
items.notes: does not necessarily indicate：并不必然表明。

items.zh: 外来物种一旦在当地扎根，清除它们可能既昂贵又困难。
items.en: Once an invasive species becomes established, removing it can be both costly and difficult.
answers: Once an invasive species becomes established, removing it can be both costly and difficult.
items.notes: become established：稳定繁衍；species 单复数同形。

items.zh: 靠近自然保护区的旅游开发，应考虑游客数量而不只是酒店收入。
items.en: Tourism development near nature reserves should consider visitor numbers rather than hotel revenue alone.
answers: Tourism development near nature reserves should consider visitor numbers rather than hotel revenue alone.
items.notes: rather than 对比评价依据。

items.zh: 游客愿意为看野生动物付费，可以为保护工作创造收入，但也需要管理干扰。
items.en: Visitors' willingness to pay for wildlife viewing can fund conservation, though disturbance still needs to be managed.
answers: Visitors' willingness to pay for wildlife viewing can fund conservation, though disturbance still needs to be managed.
items.notes: willingness to do：做某事的意愿。

items.zh: 将动物放归野外之前，必须评估当地是否仍有适合它们生存的条件。
items.en: Before animals are released into the wild, local conditions must be assessed for their suitability.
answers: Before animals are released into the wild, local conditions must be assessed for their suitability.
items.notes: be assessed for：就某方面接受评估。

items.zh: 捕捞限制若只针对一片海域，渔船可能转向缺乏监管的水域。
items.en: Fishing restrictions in one area may simply shift activity to waters with weaker oversight.
answers: Fishing restrictions in one area may simply shift activity to waters with weaker oversight.
items.notes: shift A to B：把活动转移到另一处。

items.zh: 废弃渔网可能在被遗弃很久之后，仍不断困住海洋动物。
items.en: Discarded fishing nets can continue trapping marine animals long after they have been abandoned.
answers: Discarded fishing nets can continue trapping marine animals long after they have been abandoned.
items.notes: continue doing；long after：很久之后。

items.zh: 冰川退缩既改变景观，也可能影响依赖融水的社区。
items.en: Glacier retreat changes landscapes and may also affect communities that rely on meltwater.
answers: Glacier retreat changes landscapes and may also affect communities that rely on meltwater.
items.notes: rely on：依赖；meltwater 指融化产生的水。

items.zh: 沿海地区的建筑标准，应考虑未来的海平面而不是只参考过去的风暴记录。
items.en: Coastal building standards should account for future sea levels instead of relying solely on historical storm records.
answers: Coastal building standards should account for future sea levels instead of relying solely on historical storm records.
items.notes: account for：把某因素考虑在内。

items.zh: 当保险越来越难以负担时，一些家庭可能无法继续住在高风险地区。
items.en: As insurance becomes less affordable, some households may be unable to remain in high-risk areas.
answers: As insurance becomes less affordable, some households may be unable to remain in high-risk areas.
items.notes: as 表示伴随变化的过程。

items.zh: 受气候变化影响最大的社区，未必是历史排放最多的社区。
items.en: Communities facing the greatest climate impacts are not necessarily those responsible for the highest historical emissions.
answers: Communities facing the greatest climate impacts are not necessarily those responsible for the highest historical emissions.
Communities facing the greatest climate impacts aren't necessarily those responsible for the highest historical emissions.
items.notes: those 代指 communities，避免重复。

items.zh: 富裕国家提供气候资金时，应让当地居民参与决定资金如何使用。
items.en: When wealthy nations provide climate finance, local residents should help decide how the money is spent.
answers: When wealthy nations provide climate finance, local residents should help decide how the money is spent.
items.notes: how 从句作 decide 的宾语。

items.zh: 把排放密集型工厂转移到海外，并不会自动减少全球排放。
items.en: Moving emissions-intensive factories abroad does not automatically reduce global emissions.
answers: Moving emissions-intensive factories abroad does not automatically reduce global emissions.
Moving emissions-intensive factories abroad doesn't automatically reduce global emissions.
items.notes: abroad 是副词，前面不加 to。

items.zh: 产品的环境评估需要覆盖原料开采、制造、使用和最终处置。
items.en: Environmental assessments of products need to cover extraction, manufacture, use and final disposal.
answers: Environmental assessments of products need to cover extraction, manufacture, use and final disposal.
items.notes: 并列名词保持同一语法层级。

items.zh: 电池回收若能回收关键矿物，可能降低对新矿山的需求。
items.en: Recovering critical minerals through battery recycling could reduce demand for new mines.
answers: Recovering critical minerals through battery recycling could reduce demand for new mines.
items.notes: demand for：对某物的需求。

items.zh: 风电设施的选址需要兼顾清洁能源供应与鸟类迁徙。
items.en: The siting of wind farms requires a balance between clean energy provision and bird migration.
answers: The siting of wind farms requires a balance between clean energy provision and bird migration.
items.notes: a balance between A and B：两方面的平衡。

items.zh: 屋顶太阳能可以减少土地需求，但租房者不一定有权决定安装。
items.en: Rooftop solar can limit land demand, yet tenants may have no authority to approve installation.
answers: Rooftop solar can limit land demand, yet tenants may have no authority to approve installation.
items.notes: authority to do：决定某事的权限。

items.zh: 燃油价格下降可能刺激更多驾驶，从而削弱节能车辆带来的部分收益。
items.en: Lower fuel prices may encourage more driving, weakening some of the gains from fuel-efficient vehicles.
answers: Lower fuel prices may encourage more driving, weakening some of the gains from fuel-efficient vehicles.
items.notes: weakening 作结果状语。

items.zh: 碳抵消项目的价值，取决于所声称的减排是否真实且持久。
items.en: The value of carbon offset projects depends on whether the claimed reductions are real and lasting.
answers: The value of carbon offset projects depends on whether the claimed reductions are real and lasting.
items.notes: claimed 是过去分词定语，表示所声称的。

items.zh: 城市夜间照明有助于安全，但过强的灯光也会影响夜行动物。
items.en: Urban lighting can support safety, but excessive brightness may disrupt nocturnal wildlife.
answers: Urban lighting can support safety, but excessive brightness may disrupt nocturnal wildlife.
items.notes: nocturnal：夜间活动的。

items.zh: 工业噪声即使看不见，也可能降低附近居民的生活质量。
items.en: Industrial noise can reduce nearby residents' quality of life despite being invisible.
answers: Industrial noise can reduce nearby residents' quality of life despite being invisible.
items.notes: despite 后接名词或动名词。

items.zh: 空气污染预警只有传达到高风险人群，才能帮助他们调整活动。
items.en: Air pollution alerts can help vulnerable people adjust their activities only if the messages reach them.
answers: Air pollution alerts can help vulnerable people adjust their activities only if the messages reach them.
items.notes: only if 表达必要条件。

items.zh: 仅禁止露天焚烧，未必能解决农民缺乏处理秸秆的其他办法这一问题。
items.en: Banning open burning alone may leave farmers without practical alternatives for disposing of crop residues.
answers: Banning open burning alone may leave farmers without practical alternatives for disposing of crop residues.
items.notes: leave sb without：使某人仍缺乏。

items.zh: 河流上游的污染控制，会影响下游城镇的饮用水安全。
items.en: Pollution control upstream influences the safety of drinking water in towns further downstream.
answers: Pollution control upstream influences the safety of drinking water in towns further downstream.
items.notes: upstream 与 downstream 对应上游、下游。

items.zh: 雨水收集系统应设计溢流出口，以防暴雨时储水空间不足。
items.en: Rainwater harvesting systems should include overflow outlets in case storage capacity is exceeded during heavy rain.
answers: Rainwater harvesting systems should include overflow outlets in case storage capacity is exceeded during heavy rain.
items.notes: in case 引出需要预防的情况。

items.zh: 如果垃圾处理费与垃圾量无关，家庭减少垃圾的经济动力就可能较弱。
items.en: Households may have little financial incentive to reduce waste where disposal fees are unrelated to volume.
answers: Households may have little financial incentive to reduce waste where disposal fees are unrelated to volume.
items.notes: where 在此指具有某条件的情境。

items.zh: 可降解材料不一定会在普通自然环境中迅速分解。
items.en: Biodegradable materials do not necessarily break down quickly under ordinary environmental conditions.
answers: Biodegradable materials do not necessarily break down quickly under ordinary environmental conditions.
Biodegradable materials don't necessarily break down quickly under ordinary environmental conditions.
items.notes: break down：分解；not necessarily 限定推论。

items.zh: 从纺织品中脱落的微小纤维，可能通过废水进入河流。
items.en: Tiny fibres shed from textiles may enter rivers through wastewater.
answers: Tiny fibres shed from textiles may enter rivers through wastewater.
items.notes: shed 的过去分词仍为 shed。

items.zh: 延长电子产品的保修期，可以鼓励制造商更重视耐用性。
items.en: Longer warranties for electronic products could encourage manufacturers to pay greater attention to durability.
answers: Longer warranties for electronic products could encourage manufacturers to pay greater attention to durability.
items.notes: pay attention to：关注。

items.zh: 社区参与环境监测有助于发现局部问题，但数据仍需要可靠的方法支持。
items.en: Community monitoring can reveal local environmental problems, although reliable methods are still essential.
answers: Community monitoring can reveal local environmental problems, although reliable methods are still essential.
items.notes: although 承认价值并限定条件。

items.zh: 环境修复的成功，应根据生态功能的恢复来判断，而不仅是外观变绿。
items.en: Restoration should be judged by the recovery of ecological functions, not simply by a greener appearance.
answers: Restoration should be judged by the recovery of ecological functions, not simply by a greener appearance.
items.notes: judge by：根据某标准判断。
